items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, she was before Billie, and she sang The 'White Cliffs of Dover,'

ctx.x: No. He was a trumpet player and a singer -- oh, what's his name. He died a few months ago, he was in the hospital a long while, and he had that girl who used to sing with him. Anyway, 'White Cliffs of Dover' was a big number and his band was playing it, and he told all of his band men to copy their parts, and he had somebody in the audience take down the lyrics, and Bobby Caston was a singer.
She was the first one I heard do 'God Bless The Child.' I remember her doing it before Billie Holiday.
Yeah, she was before Billie, and she sang The 'White Cliffs of Dover,' and it was a big hit -- and this guy, he made a record.
